name: Leonidas Gulaptis
bio: Leonidas Gulaptis is an actor and producer.

credits.title: The 12 Dates of Christmas
credits.overview: Christina Walker, a successful shop owner who has devoted her energy to her career at the expense of her dating life, goes on 12 dates in the 12 weeks leading up to Christmas hoping to find Mr. Right.

credits.title: The Florist
credits.overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

credits.title: Sisterhood, Inc.
credits.overview: After Megan, an ambitious CEO, loses her job, she assembles a corporate-style board of directors to manage her sister's disordered, chaotic life — and uncovers revelations of her own.

credits.title: Breaking Tradition
credits.overview: East Indian girl meets an all-American boy. When Farina’s dream of an education is thwarted, she defies her father’s wishes as she succumbs to Danny’s charm, and a future filled with unimaginable consequences.

credits.title: A Nice Girl Like You
credits.overview: Lucy Neal is thrown for a loop when she is accused of being too inhibited by her ex-boyfriend. In an effort to prove him wrong, Lucy creates a rather wild to-do list that sends her on a whirlwind and surprising journey of self-discovery, friendship, and new love.

credits.title: The Answer
credits.overview: In the quest for finding a deeper meaning to life, this is a true story of an American seeker who forsakes the worldly life to enter upon an amazing spiritual journey of self realisation.

credits.title: Gala & Godfrey The Classics
credits.overview: Love, Sex, Marriage, Divorce... just not in that order. Within the framework of a record album, Gala & Godfrey tracks the classic moments in the lives of a charming, exasperating British expat and his American wife through 12 years of their sexy, chaotic romance and divorce.
